notes: XPath is supported as a typed value, Locator.xpath(expression), rather than an xpath= or // string prefix: element nodes in document order; chained, a leading / is read from each match, as Playwright does, so a union's later branch stays absolute (.//a | .//b keeps both inside); InvalidInput at once for a malformed, prefixed or non-node-set expression. text=, >> and custom selector engines are excluded for 1.0. :has-text() and the other Playwright pseudo-classes have no exclusion decision; filter({ hasText }) and getByText cover their text matching. The combined gap stays missing until every remaining form is built or excluded.
